notes: «وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» names no one, only the blessing, so no link is read (rule 10); the source names the Imam, which the Arabic does not write

fixes.reason: THQ names the speaker, but the Arabic gives only the blessing after «وقال», so no transmitter is written.
